author: ojiudezue
title: v5.103.42 shipped: Night lights follow one simple rule
summary: Night lights follow one simple rule
why: Operator replaced the planned 3-way night-light selector with a rule (Sleep=on; else dark-only; per-room by-day opt-in) and demanded economical config, so the build adds one boolean and hides 5 colour fields. Plan review caught the main-light path still lighting night lights by day (HIGH). Reviews A+B independently caught switch night lights receiving brightness params (would fail every reconcile); C proved the canonical colour path was untested and the 'shared helper' claim false - canonical now routes through the helper with goldens. Full suite caught one stale parity oracle encoding the old entry_action contract; updated to the intended rule, verified test-only.
implications: Shipped NIGHT-LIGHT-ACTION-SELECTOR-1, LIGHT-SLEEP-ENTRYNONE-DIVERGENCE-1 at v5.103.42; card(s) sit shipped_organic pending validation. Acceptance in README_v5.103.42.md (Live criteria).
revisit_trigger: ura_activity_log: after one dusk + one Sleep night, an entry=none room with night lights (Living Room) shows night-light turn_on at dusk and in Sleep, zero night-light turn_on rows in bright daylight for rooms without night_lights_by_day, and no repeated switch.turn_on errors in HA log

refs.release_notes: Night lights: always on in Sleep when occupied; otherwise only when dark (room sensor, then outdoor Illuminance, then sun) unless the new 'Use night lights by day' box is ticked. Both controllers share one colour/brightness helper; switch night lights get a plain on; manual dims stick. One new setting; colour fields moved to Advanced.
